_comment: Approved standards the tool must not invent. A list below is an APPROVED standard (owner approval 2026-10-02); an EMPTY list means that component is not approved and the control reports it as not assessed, never as a pass. PriorityUsers stays empty: it is tenant-specific, and this file is shared by every client.

DmarcReportingAddresses._help: Addresses or @domains that must appear in every managed domain's DMARC rua (DNS-1.3). Left empty here: the address is the practice's own, so it is set as DmarcReportingAddresses in the active profile (Config/branding.psd1 or Config/profiles/<name>.psd1), which overrides this list when it is non-empty.

CommonAttachmentFileTypes._help: File extensions (no dot, lower-case) that must be in the malware policy's blocked common-attachment list. DEF-2.3. Approved list: Microsoft's documented default common attachments filter (53 types).

PriorityUsers._help: User addresses that must be in TargetedUsersToProtect of the anti-phishing policy in force. EXO-1.5. Left empty on purpose: priority users differ per tenant, so one shared list cannot be right for more than one client.

RequiredConditionalAccessTemplates._help: Ids from Config/conditional-access-baseline.json that NRG requires Enforced (for example block-legacy-auth, mfa-all-users). AAD-2.1. Approved: the five core templates that need only Entra ID P1 or Business Premium.

DistributionListMaxMembers._help: Distribution-list scan, DL-2.4. A single whole number: the largest member count one list may have, for example ["500"]. Empty means no cap is approved and the check is not assessed.

DistributionListMemberJoinRestriction._help: Distribution-list scan, DL-2.5. The join settings NRG accepts, any of Open, Closed, ApprovalRequired (for example ["Closed", "ApprovalRequired"]). Empty means join restriction is not judged.
